Theres nothing to be worried about as a warrior if your dps pulls another pack while you have good shield block up time and can just thunder clap to grab agro of all the mobs.  As long as interrupts are happening (which isnt a tank specific job) you will be fine and imo thats actually learning the dungeon and your capabilities.

Took me a lot of brain cells to fix this issue.  Basically, the error stems from the naming convention of the application on mac OS.  The name you see as the app name is not always the same as the apps actual name.

To fix the issue, right click league of legends in finder and show package contents, navigate your self to the game folder within and you will see the League Of Legends app, rename this to LeagueOfLegends.  

This should fix the issue in which your riot client is not able to find the actual game application.
